- Dropped one to man united2112, 1-3. Back to work.

That's a keeper of a performance. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-3 vs man united2112 | You: 7.7 (above average MID)
push.body:
Solid shift, BellyTb1. A 7.7 clears the bar for a midfielder, and solid is the soil good things grow in.

DID WELL
+ 32 passes (up from your usual 17). Everybody wanted the ball at your feet, and for good reason.
+ A goal against man united2112, your first since Oct 2. That's what the ball's for, and you knew it.
+ 2 shots on target pushed +0.1. Underrated work.

WORK ON
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
- 72% passing (23 of 32). Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- No key passes from 32 passes. Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.
- buddskees had the same defensive work rate trouble. Team up on it: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 1-3 to man united2112. Not our night. Our nights are coming.

Teach your feet: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

I believe in you, period. - Coach Lasso
